## Package / change

Describe the Tari use case, entry id, version and kind. Link official references
and exact compatibility evidence. Infrastructure changes must explain security impact.

## Security and permissions

List every host, tool, file and wallet permission; explain why each is needed.
Describe network/API versions tested, commands used, expected effects and results.
Never include credentials or private wallet material.

- [ ] I own this contribution or have redistribution rights; license text matches the manifest.
- [ ] The manifest declares every packaged file and actual required permission.
- [ ] I inspected the complete source and dependencies for suspicious behavior.
- [ ] No binaries, bundled dependencies, installation hooks or secrets are included.
- [ ] Changed existing entries have a higher version.
- [ ] README explains installation, compatibility, limitations and verification.
- [ ] I ran registry validation; automated checks do not certify safety.
